name: Homemade Gluten-Free Confetti Sheet Cake with Easy Chocolate Buttercream Frosting

instructions.primary_message: TO MAKE THE CAKE: Preheat oven to 350°F. Coat a 10 by 15-inch baking dish with nonstick cooking spray. Cut a piece of parchment paper to fit the bottom and press down into the dish. Set aside.
Place flour, granulated sugar, sprinkles, baking powder, and salt in a large bowl. Whisk to combine the dry ingredients.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 cups gluten-free flour
1 cup granulated sugar
¼ cup rainbow sprinkles
2 tsp baking powder
salt

instructions.primary_message: Place eggs, oil, milk, and vanilla in a medium bowl. Whisk to combine, then add to the bowl with the dry ingredients. Stir batter until just incorporated. (Don't overmix.)
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup neutral vegetable oil
¾ cup whole milk
vanilla extract

instructions.primary_message: Transfer batter to the baking dish and gently spread out in an even layer. Place cake in the preheated oven and bake until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean, 25-30 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside to cool completely, about 2 hours.
TO MAKE THE FROSTING: When the cake is almost cool, small dice butter and place in a large bowl. Set aside to soften, about 15 minutes.
When the butter has softened, using a hand-held mixer, blend on medium until smooth, about 1 minute.
Working with 1 cup at a time, sift powdered sugar and cocoa powder into the bowl with the butter. Beat well after each addition.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cups powdered sugar
½ cup cocoa powder

instructions.primary_message: Add cream, vanilla, and salt to the bowl, then beat on medium until frosting is well combined, 1-2 minutes. Increase speed to high and continue to beat until smooth, 1-2 minutes more.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp heavy whipping cream
vanilla extract
1 pinch salt

instructions.primary_message: Use a butter knife to spread frosting over the top of the cake in an even layer.
Decorate cake with additional sprinkles, then cut, share, and enjoy!
